description: Get a current New York Times bestselling books list (e.g. hardcover-fiction, hardcover-nonfiction, combined-print-and-e-book-fiction). Returns rank, title, author, description, publisher, and weeks on list. Example: books_bestsellers({ list: "hardcover-fiction" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: books_bestsellers
title: Books Bestsellers
